info.title: Clinical Cohort Recompute Service
info.description: Multi-centre clinical cohort screening with full and incremental recomputation, unit/code normalization, reconciliation gates and immutable versioned snapshots and reports. Includes a sample lineage integrity and analysis usability certification service (sampling evidence store, container graph, constraint book, usability certifications and the analysis reference book) under /lineage. All patients are fictional.

post.description:
Re-standardize the source rows a new mapping covers.

``dry_run=true`` (default) reports which rows would become standardizable
and which subjects need re-screening. Applying changes only derived
normalized values; hospital source rows are untouched.
Continue an interrupted upload from its last committed row.

get.description: Rows that could not be standardized, with the reason and source row.

post.description:
Re-run the same protocol and cutoff with the other strategy and compare
every subject decision. The two strategies must agree exactly.

Terminate future contact immediately.

Data already collected and permitted for retention still flows into the
safety analysis through the next screening run; this endpoint only stops
outreach, it does not delete history.

get.description: Full traceability from a study id back to hospital source rows.
Which sample(s) did this container belong to at time ``at``?

post.description:
Judge a container mislabelled; downstream certifications are
re-adjudicated and open cohort-run references are paused, while locked
runs keep their original certification.

Attempt to split a pool back into sources. Without measured remaining
volumes and aliquot-quality evidence the pool stays irreversible.

Resolve a frozen branch: confirm the relations to keep, reject the
rest. The confirmed chain is never silently overwritten by receipt order.

get.description:
Full traceability: original evidence, container relations, temperature
intervals, constraint version, usage restrictions and reference impact.

post.description:
Bulk re-adjudication, e.g. after a constraint-book rule change. Old
certification versions are preserved; cohort runs keep their pinned basis.

Select certifications into an open cohort run. Only ``analysis_ready``
active certifications are accepted.

Lock the run's references. Locked runs are historical: later
re-adjudications and mislabel judgements never modify them.

get.description:
Every lab report certification for one subject. A downgrade lands on
the affected assay only — the subject as a whole is never excluded.
Fictional demo identities for local verification only.
